title: Independent reading: Mark 5:21–34
subtitle: Track an interrupted narrative and its restored main thread.
overview: This passage embeds one healing scene inside another. Keep the outer story and inner story distinct so that pronouns and actions remain clear.
Participles and questions supply important detail, but finite narrative verbs advance the scene’s main sequence.

items.grc: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξηράνθη ἡ πηγὴ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτῆς.
items.en: And immediately the flow of her blood was dried up.

items.grc: θύγατερ, ἡ πίστις σου σέσωκέν σε· ὕπαγε εἰς εἰρήνην.
items.en: Daughter, your faith has saved you; go in peace.
